svg.title: Research workflow: separate pieces come together, and you iterate
svg.desc: The thesis grows from several independent pieces. On the left, under "draft and discuss": Markdown notes, for example in Obsidian or HackMD; Google Docs with advisor comments; and an existing Word draft. Below them, references kept in a Zotero library, and figure sources such as data, plotting scripts, and .drawio diagrams. Stable sections move gradually from the drafts into separate chapter files in chapters/, such as 01-introduction.tex, 02-research.tex, and 03. Zotero exports references.bib, and figures are exported as image files into figures/. main.tex brings the chapters, references, and figures together and is compiled into one thesis PDF. After a section moves into LaTeX, revise its .tex file; changes do not flow back to the drafting app. A note says to check the assembled PDF throughout.
svg.text: Revise moved sections in their .tex files
